title: Tooling: 2.07× faster partial-swap SharedPoint verify digests with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, the partial-swap fork of `SharedPointCircuit.verify` (`scripts/partial_swap/shared.py`) builds `circuit_sha256` with per-active-node and per-partial-output `json.dumps(..., separators=(',',':'))` updates. Profiling on the historical full-size circuit (`h=46`) shows about half of verify wall time in that JSON encoder path. Open [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1994) applied the same byte-identical formatter to the canonical `scripts/shared_point_circuit.py`; this package applies it to the distinct partial-swap producer copy, which still used `json.dumps`.

This PR writes the same UTF-8 digest lines with an equivalent hand-rolled formatter (`[node,null,null]`, `[node,[a,b],[common,local]]`, `[common,[t0,t1,t2],node]`), keeps every support and topology assertion, and leaves `circuit_sha256` unchanged. `certificates/partial-swap-network.json` updates only the `scripts/partial_swap/shared.py` `source_sha256` pin.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs timing only `partial_swap.shared.SharedPointCircuit(46).verify` (construction excluded; inlined local support checks included) gave median wall time **2.176 → 1.050 seconds (2.07×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every verify receipt matches the baseline checker fieldwise (`roles`, `additions`, `merged_additions`, `circuit_sha256`, flags).

Package: `research/partial-swap-digest/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/partial-swap-digest/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/partial-swap-digest/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/partial-swap-digest
python3.12 -I -B research/partial-swap-digest/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_PARTIAL_SWAP_DIGEST verify_cases=5 encoding_cases=8 certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/partial-swap-digest outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_PARTIAL_SWAP_DIGEST_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only aside from the already-committed pin-only certificate refresh. Historical support checks use `assert` and are stripped under `-O`; `circuit_sha256` identity remains the gate. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different objects): [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1793](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1793), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1861), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1922](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1922), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1984), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1994) (canonical `shared_point_circuit.py`; this applies the same formatter to the partial-swap fork), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1874](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1874). No competing open PR on the `partial_swap.shared` verify digest object at refresh. [#2001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2001)'s ExclusionCircuit / DisjointTensor support-mask files are not touched.

Douglas R. Colkitt authored the shared-point / exclusion circuits. icekylinx adapted the partial-swap producer copy. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
